name: HumanEnerDIA OVOS Skill for Industrial Energy Management
author: A Plus Engineering
description: Human-centric OVOS skill for industrial energy management (ISO 50001). Provides real-time monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, and decision support for manufacturing SMEs. Part of the WASABI HumanEnerDIA project.
examples: What's the power consumption of Compressor-1?
How much energy did Boiler-1 use yesterday?
